description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Terra (Wind)
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Trance (Terra) (0~2), removed after using Trance (Terra) two times

description.name: Trance (Terra) Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Trance (Terra) level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Terra (Wind)]

description.name: Trance (Terra) Level
description.text: Keeps track of Trance (Terra) level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Terra (Wind)]

description.name: Terra
description.text: Twenty single attacks (3.15/3.50/3.85 each) capped at 9999/19999/29999, followed by one single attack (34.60/38.06/41.52) capped at 99999 at Trance (Terra) level 0/1/2, removes Arcane Dyad Empowered: Terra (Wind) from the user
